text:
deploy-bot: Deployment started — canary rollout for service=model-serving
- tag=release-3.2.1
- commit=9fc3ab2
- env=prod-eu
- initial_traffic=5% (instances=10)
- change window: 2026-03-20 01:00-03:00 UTC
- rollout_id=roll-2005-01

maria: On it. running smoke suite against canary /v1/generate — will post results.

jon: FYI I see a small p50 bump ~+30ms on the eu-prod model pool since the canary landed. watching.

maria: smoke results: all checks OK except tokenization regression on German prompts (1/20 failing). logs: ```ERROR token mismatch at step 12```

jon: Not great. Can we keep traffic pinned at 5% and run targeted regression eval set? Recommend HOLD before promoting.

tess: @maria @jon agree — pause promotion. Please prepare rollback plan. If regressions persist we roll back to tag=release-3.2.0.

deploy-bot: Canary autoscale event — added 2 instances to canary pool. Telemetry: throughput stable. Marking rollout status: HELD at 5% pending manual check.

maria: I reran tokenizer patch locally — looks like a config mismatch in tokenizer settings between builds. Opening PR to align config. ETA ~40m.

tess: Ok keep hold. @release-coordinator-bot please create an incident note and notify stakeholders.

release-coordinator-bot: Note created: RC-2005. Canary held due to tokenization regression. Stakeholders notified: #product, #customer-success :email:.

maria: Patch merged & pushed as hotfix tag=release-3.2.1-hotfix1 commit=a4d1b2c.

deploy-bot: Hotfix deployed to canary — new tag=release-3.2.1-hotfix1. Starting canary with updated image -> traffic bumped to 7%. rollout_id=roll-2005-01-hf.

jon: Re-running regression evals... german prompt set now passes 20/20. Latency returned to baseline.

tess: Given green signals, I vote for gradual promotion: 50% then 100% after a 15m stability check.

maria: Agree. Starting promotion step.

deploy-bot: Promotion step initiated — increasing canary to 50% traffic over 3m. ETA +3m.

deploy-bot: Promotion checkpoint — 50% held for 15m, errors nominal, p50/p95 within SLO. Ready for final step.

tess: Promoting to 100% now. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Rollout complete — release-3.2.1-hotfix1 is live at 100% in prod-eu.
- previous tag=release-3.2.0 pinned for 24h as fallback.
- rollout duration: ~45m.
:tada:

jon: Thanks all. I'll push a brief note to #release-notes and update the changelog entry.
